The findings span the harness sources: GSPC axis 22: long-horizon-reliability (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 4: continuity, GSPC axis 7: machinery-conformity, GSPC axis 5: conformance, GSPC axis 8: care, GSPC axis 11: art5-safeguard, GSPC axis 6: openness, GSPC axis 21: sycophancy (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 14: jail, GSPC axis 16: oversight (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 1: governance, GSPC axis 2: safety, GSPC axis 20: deception (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 15: memory-poisoning (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 13: affect.
